symptom: A pluggable widget's text-template parameter bound across an association — `fieldset fs (legend: '{1}', legendParams: ({1} = Repro.Parent_Child/Label))` — passed check and exec and failed the build: [CE1365] "Attribute 'Repro.Child.Label' is not an attribute of entity 'Repro.Parent'." The stored AttributeRef had the right Attribute and EntityRef null. describe then printed the parameter as the bare `{1} = Label`, which re-executes into CE1613 "The selected attribute 'Repro.Parent.Label' no longer exists." (#1494). The companion report #1495 (an expression parameter stored in AttributeRef.Attribute, spaces stripped) was already fixed in v0.25.0 by #823 and only needed a pin.
cause: The executor resolved the hops all along (buildClientTemplateParams -> resolveTemplateAssociationPath fills ClientTemplateParameter.AttributeRefSteps); widgetobj.SerializeColumnClientTemplateParameter hard-coded `EntityRef: nil` and never read the field, although attributeEntityRefBSON, which builds exactly that IndirectEntityRef, sat in the same file for column attributes. On the read side the pluggable describer's extractTextTemplateParameters was a copy of the core extractClientTemplateParameters loop that never learned associationTemplateParamPath.
fix: SerializeColumnClientTemplateParameter writes attributeEntityRefBSON(param.AttributeRefSteps); extractClientTemplateParameters now delegates to extractTextTemplateParameters, which gained the association path and the trimmed expression — one reader instead of two.
insight: The reported statement was one of three victims: the same serializer writes widget-level templates, object-list item templates (Accordion group headerText) and Data grid 2 column templates, and the pre-fix binary on a blank 11.12.4 app gives CE1365 on all three — so enumerate the serializer's callers (grep BuildClientTemplateWithTextAndParams) before writing the repro, not after. Dump the stored ClientTemplateParameter before theorising: Attribute correct + EntityRef null says the resolver is fine and the encoder dropped a field it was handed, which rules out the whole entity-context investigation binding-context.md would otherwise send you on. For the expression half, do not trust the report's version: it was filed against v0.24.0 and CHANGELOG 0.25.0 already describes the fix; reproduce on main first, then pin it by stubbing each guard separately — the visitor's expressionSourceText (stub: `if1=1then'A'else'B'`) and isTemplateExpression (stub: `M.Job.if 1 = 1 …`) each reproduce one half of the reported message. The describe twin is the #977 drift a second time: #977 shared the source-variable sub-resolver and left the loop duplicated, so the next feature (association paths) landed in one copy only — share the loop, not a helper.
test: mdl/backend/widgetobj/template_param_association_test.go (fails with EntityRef <nil> when builder.go is reverted); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_sourcevariable_test.go TestBothDescribers_RenderAnAssociationPath (pluggable renders [Label]); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_template_expression_1495_test.go
